class.name: HTMLInputElement
class.brief_description: A handle to an HTML input element.
class.description: Returned by element queries and by [method HTMLLayout.create_element] for [code]<input>[/code]. [HTMLLabel] supports single-line text and checkboxes. The value and checked state apply to the current layout. Changing them from script emits no user editing signals. Text inputs keep their current value separate from the [code]value[/code] attribute. A checkbox has a separate checked state and uses the [code]value[/code] attribute for its value, with [code]on[/code] as the default.

method.name: get_selection_end
method.description: Returns the end of the single-line text selection. Other input types and invalid handles return [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_selection_start
method.description: Returns the start of the single-line text selection. Other input types and invalid handles return [code]-1[/code].

method.name: set_selection_range
method.description: Sets the single-line selection using Godot string character indices. Indices snap to grapheme boundaries. Equal indices set the caret.

members.member: The current text or checkbox value.
The current checked state. Before a script or user sets it, the state follows the [code]checked[/code] attribute.
